elements.name: long-distance bus station in Addis Ababa
very long winding queue of people
shorter young man seen from behind with backpack
taller young man seen from behind in denim jacket

wrong_setting: Generic modern glass-and-column terminal with a digital departures monitor and green overhead sign; the crowd reads as a loose cluster rather than a queue, and nothing identifies Addis Ababa or Ethiopia.
notes: Remove the taller man's olive backpack so only the shorter man carries one, replace the garbled monitor and sign with plain shapes, add a small ticket window, and make the crowd a long queue winding toward it in a recognisably Addis Ababa bus station.
